title: Evaluate the two-neuron network at one input
description: You substitute a scalar into the stored network expression.

steps.description: You set x_example to 10. This value becomes the input to both hidden neurons.

steps.question: Where does the output bias c enter this prediction?
steps.answer: It is added once after both weighted ReLU outputs. Each hidden neuron has its own input weight and bias inside relu.

steps.description: You compute y_example from the stored parameters in one expression. This block evaluates the network without updating its weights.
You print the prediction with four decimal places. The recording reports y=7.0000 for x=10.
